title: Charlatan
html:
Charlatan is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around trickery and deceit. Astarion and the hireling Kree Derryck have this background.

“
You're an expert in manipulation, prone to exaggeration and more than happy to profit from it. Bending the truth and turning allies against each other will lead to greater success down the road.
„

Background features

  • Deception Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Deception) Ability Checks.
  • Sleight of Hand Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
Act 1
Blighted Village 25 Just Passing Through Trick the goblins in Moonhaven.
  • Using Illithid and Intimidation lines, as well as bribing the goblin guards does not work.
25 Mirror Master Trick or intimidate the magic mirror in the Thayan cellar.
Goblin Camp 25 Anything for a Profit Steal the toe ring from Crusher without getting caught.
  • Shared with ⁠What Price Dignity? and mutually exclusive with ⁠Give Them a Show.
25 Spiked Poison the beer in the goblin camp.
  • Shared with ⁠Culling the Crowd and ⁠Now It's a Party!
25 Very Important Parasite Deceive any of the guards in the goblin camp.
  • Using Illithid and Intimidation lines does not work.
Grymforge 50 A Friend to All Gain access to Grymforge peacefully by lying to the raft patrol.
Mountain Pass 30 Silver Blades, Silver Tongue Convince Kith'rak Voss to leave without violence.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Conquer the Conquerors.
Overgrown Tunnel 30 One of Us Use the hag's mask to peacefully bypass her thralls.
  • Granted when a party member with the mask equipped crosses the waterfall behind the corridor guarded by the masked thralls.
  • To protect from the effects of the mask,  Protection from Evil and Good can be used.
Ravaged Beach 20 Cheese Your Way Through Talk your way past the bandits and enter the chapel.
  • Must convince Gimblebock to flee and then trick Andorn to let the party inside. If the gang outside is fought, the inspiration is not granted.
  • If Gimblebock's gang is chased off and then attacked, the inspiration is given as usual.
20 Flexible Diplomacy Betray the tieflings after convincing them to free Lae'zel.
  • The party must attack the tieflings through the dialogue.
  • If Lae'zel died while escaping the Nautiloid, this inspiration cannot be obtained.
Shattered Sanctum 25 Devil's Advocate Interrogate the dead mind flayer without drawing suspicion.
25 A Better Offer Convince the pit spiders to attack the goblins.
  • The inspiration can only be obtained with Speak with Animals active.
Underdark 30 Warmonger Cause Glut to stage a coup - then pick a side.
  • Report to Spaw on eliminating the duergar near the Ebonlake while having Glut as a party follower.
Waukeen's Rest 30 The Importance of Networking Talk your way into the Zhentarim hideout.
  • The inspiration is granted after the party convince Zarys to let them in.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 The Devil's in the Details Expose a half-truth in the orthon's contract with Raphael.
  • Requires the interacting party member to succeed a passive  DC 14 Insight Check in the initial dialogue with Yurgir to detect a tricky clause in the text of the contract. Bards and Warlocks pass the check automatically.
  • Shared with the ⁠Killer Poetry inspiration.
Last Light Inn 50 Always Trust a Dishonest Person Expose Marcus to the Harpers.
  • Only available if Tieflings weren't saved -- if Mol is alive she will vouch for the party instead of Marcus.
50 Shuffling the Board Rig the game of lanceboard.
50 Tadpole Solidarity Go along with Marcus' plan.
  • Granted only if Marcus vouches for the party at the entrance and is not exposed to Jaheira. Thus, only obtainable if Tieflings weren't saved.
Moonrise Towers 50 Clear Conscience Successfully lie to Z'rell about the fate of the goblins.
60 Know thy Clientele Instigate Z'rell into showing off her gifts from the Absolute.
50 Pied Piper Successfully influence the gnolls, either to break free or continue being subservient.
Moonrise Towers Prison 50 Not to Worry, I Have a Permit Evade repercussions when speaking to the Moonrise prisoners.
  • This can be achieved by either convincing the guards to let the party talk to the prisoners, by talking to the prisoners unobserved, or by killing all the guards and then talking to a prisoner.
Reithwin Town 60 Takes One to Know One Expose the true form of the toll collector by removing all her gold armour.
  • This requires killing all her minions in combat.
60 Tricks of the Trade Successfully pretend to drink from the steins of ale.
  • During dialog with Thisobald Thorm, pass all three Sleight of Hand checks to feign drinking.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 75 Morally Grey Betray the trust of Moonrise or Lastlight.
  • * The party must allow Marcus to kidnap Isobel from Last Light Inn, but then free the Nightsong. OR, prevent Marcus from kidnapping Isobel and then let Balthazar transport the Nightsong from Shadowfell to Moonrise.
Act 3
Multiple locations 220 Always Trust a Dishonest Person[1] Betray a recently forged alliance.

This inspiration has multiple mutually exclusive options to gain (granted once to whichever comes first):

  • Accept Gortash's bargain. At any point after that, if Gortash becomes hostile, the inspiration is rewarded.
  • Enter combat against Mystic Carrion after obtaining the quest Find Mystic Carrion's Servant.[2]
  • Betray Nightsong to Lorroakan.
  • Face Orin in the Bhaal Temple without killing Gortash after telling Orin that you would.
  • Turn down The Emperor and release Orpheus.
  • Choosing a side in the conflict between the Guild and the Zhentarim throughout Aid the Underduke and then betraying them does not grant this inspiration.
Lower City 170 Grave Prospector Retrieve the grave's gold from Bugthimble.
170 Perks of the Trade Obtain a rebate for your room at the Elfsong Tavern.
  • Trying to persuade Alan Alyth to give a discount by appealing to the murder does not grant this inspiration. Using any other ability checks, including class-based options, do grant it.
170 Saving a Fellow Tale-Spinner Save Volo from an untimely death.
  • Rescue Volo from the angry mob in front of the Steel Watch Foundry.
170 Silver-Tongue's Better Than Any Key Gain access to Avery's workshop.
  • The party can either sneak in or gain access with the password obtained during Investigate the Suspicious Toys.
170 The News of My Deeds Was Greatly Exaggerated Rig the Baldur's Mouth printing press.
  • Complete the quest Stop the Presses.
Rivington 135 Cheating the Cheater Find the source of the genie's trick and take it.
  • Pickpocket the Djinni Ring from Akabi and then win the jackpot. The inspiration is granted after Akabi awards you the "prize".
  • Shared with ⁠A Grand Prize!.
135 Never Trust an Honest Person Lie to make your way into the big barn.
135 Seams of Lavender and Thyme Deceive your way into the circus.
  • The inspiration cannot be gained if the party have already entered the circus' territory through an alternative route (e.g., from the Open Hand Temple). In this case, the gatekeeper Klaus behaves as if they have already convinced him.
135 Stuffed Bears in the Closet Blackmail the merchant.
Undercity 170 Friends in Low Places Gain access to the Undercellar through Tusgront.
220 Woman of Her Word Side with the Nine-Fingers against the Zhentarim.
  • At the conclusion of Aid the Underduke, support Nine-Fingers.
220 Winged Serpent of Gold Side with the Zhentarim against Nine-Fingers.
  • At the conclusion of Aid the Underduke, support the Zhentarim.
  • Roah Moonglow or Friol must survive and escape to the Guildhall in the previous stage of the quest.
Wyrm's Crossing 170 Not so Infallible After All Evade being arrested by a Steel Watcher.
170 Rock-Solid Alibi Manage to convince the Flaming Fist to let you into Wyrm's Rock.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 135 Nothing's Not for Sale Convince the Flaming Fist quartermaster to trade with you.

Cut and inactive Background Goals

  • Little White Lies: Lie to Arabella about the fate of her parents. Arabella can be lied to after the party find her parents, but the trigger for this inspiration event is a specific unreachable scene with Withers and Arabella.
  • Not My First Time: Does not trigger as of game ver 4.1.17209685.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ The Act 2 and Act 3 inspirations named Always Trust a Dishonest Person are separate so both can be triggered in a single playthrough. (two inspirations sharing the same name)
  2. ↑ The inspiration is still rewarded even after the quest is completed in favor of Mystic Carrion. The only prerequisite is for the party to attack Carrion directly, it does not work if the undead is already turned hostile (e.g. by destroying its heart).
